en.backfillIncludeNoCwd: Include sessions without cwd (private palace only)
en.backfillIntro: Distils past dsh sessions into the palace, turn by turn: each session is written into the project store matching its own cwd. Turns already captured are skipped by idempotency key, so starting again resumes where it stopped. Backfilled memories never enter the due-today queue.
en.backfillPollFailed: Status unreachable — the server may have restarted; start again to resume (idempotent)
en.backfillRouteHint: Failures are usually because the model a past session used is not available here: set provider/model in cordis.yml, or run one turn with the target model first (backfill reuses the model currently in use) and retry — finished turns are skipped automatically.
en.backfillSkippedDetail: Excluded: subagent {subagent} · seeded {seeded} · no cwd {noCwd} · outside window {tooOld} · unreadable {unreadable}
en.backfillTruncated: Candidates exceed the total turn budget: only the most recent sessions run this time — raise the budget or run in batches
en.beliefEvidenceEmpty: Evidence memories were purged; the belief is kept
en.beliefHint: One-line conclusions the butler consolidated from multiple memories; expand the evidence to inspect the underlying memories
en.beliefNone: No consolidated beliefs yet; the butler induces them once memories accumulate
en.benchNote: Walk uses the same map as the guided tour and counts as a visit
en.benchPlaceholder: Name a room by keyword or meaning…
en.corridorEmpty: No memories yet — the bird’s-eye view appears after a few memories arrive.
en.corridorFloorHint: Click a room or the index to filter the palace list
en.corridorNoEdges: No edges yet — they form via distill, supersede, or contradiction
en.dueBadgeLabel: {n} due today — click to filter in the library
en.emptyHint: Adjust the rooms above, or place a new memory
en.entityEmpty: No entities in this palace yet; they appear after you save memories that mention them
en.entityHint: People, projects, tools and concepts extracted from memories; open one to see every memory that mentions it
en.episodeAroundEmpty: No other episodes within the proximity window
en.episodeHint: Browse experiences grouped by session; group heads carry a one-line summary generated at ingest. Click "Nearby" on an entry to see what else happened around that moment
en.episodeSummaryMissing: (No summary yet for this session: run a history backfill to add one)
en.exportMirrorHint: One .md per memory, roamable in Obsidian
en.factEmpty: No facts yet; facts extracted from memories during ingestion will appear here
en.importDone: Import complete: {imported} entries written ({embedded} embedded in place), {edges} edges linked, {dangling} dangling edges dropped
en.importJsonHint: JSON product of engram_export (lossless round trip)
en.importKeepDuplicates: Force-import content duplicates (only when their id is unoccupied)
en.importMdHint: Re-parse exported MD (lossy: defaults filled in)
en.importRedactedNotice: This file is a redacted-view export: contents are truncated previews; importing will store the preview text, not the originals.
en.importSummary: {total} entries: {fresh} new · {dup} duplicates · {conflict} conflicts; {edges} edges ({dangling} dangling will be dropped); entities: {entitiesNew} new / {entitiesMerged} merged. Only checked entries will be written.
en.importTooLarge: File is too large (limit {limit}) and cannot be imported.
en.jevHostHint: Providers and their API keys are configured in DSH only; this panel just picks one. An empty provider means "use the one this session already runs on"; an empty endpoint is derived from that provider as "{base}/systemone".
en.jevIntro: Jev System-One adjudication: three-way ruling (merge / accept / defer) for ambiguous memories before they are written, plus contradiction confirmation. The provider and its API key come from DSH, so nothing secret is stored here; settings take effect immediately after saving, no restart, and when Jev is unavailable the plugin falls back to the pure four-rule disposition.
en.jevModelHint: Any model name can be typed here; left empty, the first JEV model of the provider is used. "Load provider models" suggests JEV models only — the others do not answer the System One protocol, so they are not offered.
en.jevObsEmpty: No records yet; they appear when Jev adjudicates a write after being enabled
en.jevObsTitle: Recent adjudications (this process, up to 50, cleared on restart)
en.jevThresholdsTitle: Adjudication thresholds (advanced cordis.yml config, read-only here)
en.logCount: {n} entries · both stores merged, newest first
